manual_notes: Protocol subcomponents, the public host-service catalog, descriptor-derived metadata, bidirectional coverage tests and injected guest transport are implemented. The selected consolidated specification simultaneously retains compatible root-facade/client requirements, later prohibits root business clients and says the root contains only package documentation, and then requires root directory guest assembly. Pinned June and July sources expose a real root SDK with Services clients. These conflicting scope statements prevent one unambiguous full-scope completion judgment; a human must choose the intended version. This does not imply the implemented SDK is abandoned.

sources.observed_facts: Root package exposes the dynamic SDK and Services interface with Runtime, Storage, Cache, Lock and other guest clients.
Root directory assembles capability clients with injected transport.
Private descriptors derive from the public protocol/hostservices catalog.
Tests inspect protocol aliases, guest selectors, dispatcher coverage, orphan selectors and absence of per-domain stubs.
Earlier June snapshot also exposes the root guest SDK, so the mismatch is not inferred solely from the latest snapshot.
